title: 第14章 出狱搜查，押送雷老虎!
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
晨光刺破了天牢的阴霾。

    值班的狱卒们推开大门，脚还没迈进去，就被眼前的景象钉在了原地。

    地上的血迹虽然擦过了，但石板缝里的暗红依旧刺眼。

    更让他们头皮发麻的是消息——昨晚暴动，死了两个。

    何万，刘海峰。

    平日里在丁字号的老油条，一夜之间，凉透了。

    “听说了吗，昨晚红莲魔教来劫狱了。”

    “真的假的？那咱们这儿怎么没塌？”

    “多亏了陈然，听说他一人守住了七号房，还配合六扇门的大人们平息了暴动。”

    “陈然，那个病秧子？”

    众人的目光齐刷刷投向走廊尽头。

    目光尽头，陈然坐在太师椅上，手里端着茶盏，热气袅袅上升，模糊了他的面容。

    两个新来的狱卒站在他身后，正卖力地给他捏着肩膀。

    “陈哥，这力道行吗？”

    “左边，再重得点。”

    陈然抿了一口茶，眼皮都没抬。

    这副派头，倒是比那位王校尉还要足。

    那些平日里对陈然爱搭不理的狱卒，此刻只觉得脸颊发烫。

    谁能想到，这个平时唯唯诺诺的小透明，竟然是深藏不露的狠角色？

    “陈……陈哥……”

    张文搓着手，腰弯成了虾米，一脸谄媚地凑了过来。

    “您昨晚真是神勇。以前是兄弟我有眼不识泰山，您大人不记小人过。”

    陈然放下茶盏，瓷杯磕在桌面上，发出清脆的声响。

    张文的心跟着颤了一下。

    “张哥客气。”

    陈然从怀里摸出几块碎银子，随手扔在桌上。

    银子在桌面上打着转，发出诱人的光泽。

    “昨晚大家都受惊了，拿去买点酒，压压惊。”

    众狱卒的眼睛瞬间亮了。

    “多谢陈哥！”

    “陈哥大气！”

    马屁声如潮水般涌来。

    陈然站起身，拍了拍衣摆上并不存在的灰尘。

    “行了，干活去吧。”

    “我出去办点事。”

    “是！陈哥慢走！”

    众狱卒齐声应喝，腰杆挺得笔直，目送陈然离开。

    ……

    走出天牢大门。

    阳光有些刺眼。

    陈然眯起眼，深吸了一口带着烟火气的空气。

    这是他穿越以来，第一次在白日走出这个阴森的牢笼。

    京城的街道宽阔，两旁店铺林立。

    虽然是大魏末年，但这天子脚下，依旧维持着表面的繁华。

    叫卖声，讨价还价声，车马声，汇成一股巨大的声浪。

    陈然混在人群中，毫不起眼。

    他没有流连，按照鬼手李四给的地址，一路向南。

    穿过繁华的闹市区，周围的景象逐渐萧条。

    破败的房屋，满地的污水，还有缩在墙角眼神麻木的流民。
content_en:
The morning light pierced the haze of Tianlao.

    The guards on duty pushed open the door, and before they even stepped in, they were nailed to the spot by the sight in front of them.

    Although the blood stains on the ground have been wiped away, the dark red in the gaps between the stone slabs is still dazzling.

    What made them even more numb was the news - two people died in the riot last night.

    He Wan, Liu Haifeng.

    The old fried dough sticks that usually sit in a T-shape became completely cold overnight.

    "Have you heard that the Red Lotus Demon Cult came to rob the prison last night?"

    "Really? Then why didn't our place collapse?"

    "Thanks to Chen Ran. I heard that he guarded Room 7 by himself and cooperated with the adults from the Six Doors to quell the riot."

    "Chen Ran, that sick man?"

    Everyone's eyes were directed towards the end of the corridor.

    At the end of his gaze, Chen Ran was sitting on the Grand Master's chair, holding a tea cup in his hand. The heat was rising, blurring his face.

    Two new jailers stood behind him, squeezing his shoulders vigorously.

    "Brother Chen, is this strength enough?"

    "Left side, heavier."

    Chen Ran took a sip of tea without raising his eyelids.

    This style is even better than that of Captain Wang.

    Those jailers who usually ignored Chen Ran only felt their cheeks burning at this moment.

    Who would have thought that this little transparent person who is usually submissive would actually be a ruthless person who hides his secrets?

    "Chen...Brother Chen..."

    Zhang Wen rubbed his hands, bent like a shrimp, and came over with a flattering look on his face.

    "You were so brave last night. We used to be brothers and I couldn't see the mountains. You don't remember the faults of villains."

    Chen Ran put down the tea cup, and the porcelain cup hit the table with a crisp sound.

    Zhang Wen's heart trembled.

    "Brother Zhang, you're welcome."

    Chen Ran took out a few broken pieces of silver from his arms and threw them on the table.

    The silver was spinning on the table, giving off an alluring sheen.

    "Everyone was frightened last night. Let's buy some wine to calm down the shock."

    The eyes of all the jailers suddenly lit up.

    "Thank you, Brother Chen!"

    "Brother Chen is awesome!"

    The flattery came flooding in.

    Chen Ran stood up and patted the non-existent dust on his clothes.

    "Okay, let's go to work."

    "I'm going out to do something."

    "Yes! Brother Chen, walk slowly!"

    All the jailers shouted in unison, straightened their backs, and watched Chen Ran leave.

    …

    Walk out of the prison gate.

    The sun is a bit dazzling.

    Chen Ran narrowed his eyes and took a deep breath of the pyrotechnic air.

    This was the first time since his time travel that he had walked out of this gloomy prison in daylight.

    The streets in the capital are wide and lined with shops.

    Although it was the last years of the Wei Dynasty, the superficial prosperity was still maintained under the emperor's feet.

    The sounds of hawking, bargaining, and the sounds of carriages and horses merged into one huge sound.

    Chen Ran blended in the crowd and was inconspicuous.

    He didn't linger, and headed south according to the address given by Ghost Hand Li Si.

    Passing through the bustling downtown area, the surrounding scene gradually became depressing.

    Ruined houses, sewage all over the ground, and homeless people huddled in corners with numb eyes.
title_en: Chapter 14: Release from prison, search, escort Lei Hu!
